items.value: Enjoy the great outdoors on a farming trip with Baldi and friends! Help Baldi stack hay bales in Haystack Fever.
Help the farmer by stacking the falling hay as quickly as you can!
Thanks to you, all the work is done sooner (Rather then later)!
You lost?! Try better next time!
Are your reflexes bad? Let's make sure it's not by stacking fast in Haystack Fever!
I will toss you some hay bales, and I need you to catch them!

Once you have a hay bale in your crate, I will move on to launch the next
hay bale towards you.

Once you have a hay bale in your crate, I will speed up.
Pay attention! Things can get pretty crazy!
Be quick though! If you take too long, you'll miss out and get a strike. Sorry about that!
Get three and that's game over!
Looks like the animals escaped their enclosures, lets get them back in!
